# BabakPlayer

> Android media player app that imports shared media parts from BabakCast (or WhatsApp) and plays them one after another as one playlist.

## What it does

BabakPlayer is the companion receiver app for BabakCast. It accepts shared media files via Android's share intent and plays them as a continuous queue. Captioned shares are grouped by caption and sorted by filename; other shares retain the supplied file order. The app retains access to original files where possible and otherwise copies them into app-private storage. Supports audio (mp3) and video (mp4, mkv, mov, webm), English, Persian (RTL) and Danish localization. Google Cast support (Nest speakers for audio, Chromecast for audio and video) is included only in the full build; the F-Droid (foss) build has none.

## Key features

- Share-to-import: receive files from WhatsApp or any share-capable app
- Continuous playback queue: shares without a caption keep the supplied file order; captioned shares are grouped by caption and sorted by filename
- Google Cast support (Nest speakers, Chromecast), full build only
- English, Persian (RTL) and Danish UI
- Local-first: no account, no cloud sync, no backend
- Autoplay-next with configurable seek interval

## Architecture

- Language: Kotlin
- Framework: Jetpack Compose, ExoPlayer, Google Cast SDK (full build only)
- Architecture: Clean Architecture + MVVM
- Build tool: Gradle (Kotlin DSL)
- Min SDK: Android 7.0 (API 24)
